data.prompt: Which combination creates the clearest new direction?

options.text: Repeat Maya's transportation idea without addressing the others.
options.feedback: Not quite. Repeating one idea overlooks the other viewpoints.

options.text: Combine transportation access, cost controls, communication, and a pilot into a coordinated recommendation.
options.feedback: Correct. This combines proposals and concerns into a possible implementation strategy.

options.text: Select whichever idea was mentioned most often.
options.feedback: Not quite. Frequency alone does not establish the best solution.
